title: New county emergency operations center
summary: As of September 17, the Maui Emergency Management Agency (MEMA) hopes its new emergency operations center will be running by October 1st, and the chair raised holding a future commission meeting there. The opening has slipped repeatedly: the move was pushed from June to July 15, then a roof leak over the computer room caused further delay. MEMA had invited commissioners to a July 24 blessing for the center.
